description: This file declares an API for managing a vector of instance number based selectors, used to implement instance-based permissions. It includes function prototypes for initialization, destruction, filling, adding, removing, and searching entries within the vector, as well as retrieving permissions for instances.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys an instance selector vector, optionally destroying its entries.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Unwatch
methods.description: Unwatches the vector, perhaps removing event listeners or updating internal state.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Fill
methods.description: Fills the vector with a specified number of entries, all with the given permission bitmask.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a selector to the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a selector from the vector at a specified index.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds the index of a given selector within the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_GetPermissionForInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the permission bitmask for a specific instance based on the vector.
